7.7.8 Controlling multiple StateMachine Instances
The
ActionListItem
approach offers the ability to start/stop
StateMachine
in-
stances, as it might be needed in a project-specific environment.
To reduce complexity in configuration there should be only one level of
StateMachine
nesting. Therefore, only the
StateMachine
with the role
Controller
should be
used to Start/Stop other
StateMachine
instances, called
Agents
.
[SWS_SM_CONSTR_00019] Usage of ActionListItem "StartStateMachine" and
"StopStateMachine"
⌈
Only the
StateMachine
with the role
Controller
shall use
the
ActionListItem
"StartStateMachine" and "StopStateMachine".
